scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/demo-api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/demo-api --reload --reload-dir apps/demo-api/app --port 8787
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && uv run --project apps/demo-api ruff check apps/demo-api tools
scripts.brand:trace: uv run --no-project --with pillow --with potracer --with numpy python -m tools.brand.trace
scripts.brand:svg: uv run --no-project python -m tools.brand.build_logo && uv run --no-project python -m tools.brand.build_assets
scripts.brand:build: npm run brand:fonts && npm run brand:svg && npm run brand:png && npm run brand:pack && npm run brand:tokens
scripts.brand:fonts: uv run --no-project --with fonttools --with brotli python -m tools.brand.fonts_for_render
